themes_detail.label: Tree Emergency: Dead Trees & Overgrowth Surge
themes_detail.summary: Dead/dying tree complaints spiked to 4 this week vs. 0.2 weekly average (1500% increase, z-score 8.66), while overgrown tree/branch complaints hit 5 this week vs. 1.6 average (208% increase, z-score 4.85)—a converging environmental hazard emerging THIS WEEK that poses fall/winter safety risks.
evidence: Dead/dying tree complaints: 4 THIS WEEK vs. 0.2 weekly baseline (1500% spike, z-score 8.66)
Overgrown tree/branch complaints: 5 THIS WEEK vs. 1.6 weekly baseline (208% spike, z-score 4.85)
Two simultaneous tree-related 311 spikes suggest infrastructure neglect or weather-triggered vulnerability
reporting_angles: Interview Parks Dept about tree maintenance backlog and whether recent storms or drought have triggered die-offs in Sunnyside/Woodside
Canvass block by block to document which trees residents identify as hazardous; obtain Parks inspection records for this district

themes_detail.label: Unleashed Dogs & Animal Abuse Uptick
themes_detail.summary: Unleashed dog complaints surged to 5 last week vs. 0.6 weekly average (700% increase, z-score 6.29), while animal-abuse complaints reached 9 two weeks ago vs. 2.1 average (324% increase, z-score 3.75)—a public safety and animal welfare pattern emerging over the PAST 2 WEEKS with potential enforcement gaps.
evidence: Unleashed dog complaints: 5 last week vs. 0.6 weekly baseline (700% spike, z-score 6.29)
Animal-abuse complaints: 9 two weeks ago vs. 2.1 weekly baseline (324% spike, z-score 3.75)
Dual spike suggests possible dog park absence, leash law non-enforcement, or abuse reporting uptake
reporting_angles: Interview NYPD and Animal Care & Control about enforcement patrols and response times in Sunnyside/Woodside over the past 2 weeks
Talk to residents and dog owners about perceived safety concerns and whether they've witnessed unleashed dogs or abuse incidents

themes_detail.label: Street Noise Complaint Wave
themes_detail.summary: Street/sidewalk noise complaints jumped to 48 three weeks ago vs. 21 weekly average (129% increase, z-score 3.55)—a sustained MONTH-OLD trend suggesting construction, bars, or transit disruption impacting residential quality of life.
evidence: Street/sidewalk noise: 48 complaints three weeks ago vs. 21 weekly baseline (129% spike, z-score 3.55)
Spike is 3 weeks old, suggesting a persistent source rather than one-off event
No corresponding residential noise spike, pointing to external/commercial sources
reporting_angles: Map the 48 noise complaints geographically to identify a specific corridor or venue (bar, restaurant, construction site, transit hub)
Interview 311 callers and Community Board to identify perceived sources; cross-reference with DOE permit data

themes_detail.label: Litter Basket Infrastructure Gap
themes_detail.summary: Litter basket requests spiked to 5 two weeks ago vs. 0.5 weekly average (900% increase, z-score 5.2)—a demand signal for sanitation infrastructure that may reflect garbage accumulation problems or enforcement gaps in the district.
evidence: Litter basket requests: 5 two weeks ago vs. 0.5 weekly baseline (900% spike, z-score 5.2)
Spike is 2 weeks old and may indicate a specific trash crisis or emerging hotspot
Long-running CB budget requests for park/amenity upgrades suggest broader sanitation infrastructure shortfall
reporting_angles: Identify which blocks/intersections filed the 5 litter basket requests; visit to assess visible litter and rodent pressure
Interview DSNY about basket inventory and deployment strategy in CD 402; compare basket density to other Queens districts

themes_detail.label: Traffic & Enforcement Friction
themes_detail.summary: Traffic complaints hit 3 three weeks ago vs. 0.5 weekly average (500% spike, z-score 5.0), while real-time enforcement complaints reached 6 vs. 1.8 average (243% spike, z-score 4.39)—a convergence suggesting either congestion worsening or police/traffic agent presence disrupting residents THREE WEEKS AGO.
evidence: Traffic complaints: 3 three weeks ago vs. 0.5 weekly baseline (500% spike, z-score 5.0)
Real-time enforcement complaints: 6 three weeks ago vs. 1.8 weekly baseline (243% spike, z-score 4.39)
Spikes are 3 weeks old; convergence suggests either congestion event or localized enforcement surge
reporting_angles: Check NYPD and Traffic Enforcement agent logs for activity spikes 3 weeks ago; interview officers about operational changes
Cross-reference with construction permits, special events, or transit service changes on Queens Boulevard or major corridors
